headline.text: L3 ML4 Level 2 clean marked complete with *7+ sections* still awaiting ATP — verification checklist missed during Saturday crew shortage.

summary: Three sanitation gaps flagged across weekend cleaning shifts — L3 ML4 ATP incomplete on multiple sections, L1 S2 bark breaker deferred to Monday, L1 S4 Conbar initially missed then recovered. L1 S2 almond peels found in Tunnel 2; no disposition documented. Electrical work at L1 S1 (drilling, cutting) requires cleaning Monday morning before startup.

food_safety.title: Almond peels found in Tunnel 2
food_safety.summary: Foreign material (almond peels) discovered in Tunnel 2 on L1 S2 line; no follow-up disposition or root cause documented in window.
food_safety.status: Open, no documented follow-up or corrective action.

food_safety.title: Electrical work near production areas — metal debris risk
food_safety.summary: Drilling, copper wire cutting, and possible stud welding on lower level and incline conveyor of L1 S1; cleaning required before Monday startup.
food_safety.status: Identified, cleaning planned for Monday morning pre-startup.

sanitation.title: S4 Conbar initially not cleaned
sanitation.summary: Conbar found uncleaned during Friday walk; crew cleaned overnight and reported ready for ATP verification by Saturday morning.
sanitation.status: Resolved — cleaning completed, awaiting ATP verification.

sanitation.title: ML4 Level 2 clean — ATP verification incomplete on 7+ sections
sanitation.summary: Level 2 clean marked complete, but ATP still needed on TG 3&4, Dep 2, Sweeco 1 & 2 south sides, Rollers Sec 1 & 2, and Scraper; operator absences Saturday may have contributed.
sanitation.status: Open, awaiting ATP verification completion before Monday startup.

sanitation.title: S2 bark breaker teeth cleaning deferred to Monday
sanitation.summary: Bark breaker visual inspection failed due to incomplete cleaning on teeth; metal detector passed and reassembled on line, remaining cleaning deferred to Monday startup.
sanitation.status: Deferred to Monday startup; will not delay CPK order per crew lead.

opportunities.text: Review foreign-material investigation SOP for Tunnel 2 almond peels — no disposition, source identification, or corrective action was documented in the 24-hour window.

Add maintenance hot-work pre-notification to FSQA for S1 line — electrical work (drilling, cutting, welding) happened without advance cleaning coordination, flagged only when shift lead asked post-work.
Consider requiring real-time ATP sign-off in the cleaning checklist itself, not post-completion review — based on ML4's Level 2 clean marked complete with 7+ sections still awaiting verification.
